I am an architect, full-stack engineer, and product builder.

I like researching hard problems, turning ideas into working products, and
building high-quality tools that make other builders faster. My work spans
developer tooling, AI-assisted engineering, DeFi systems, mobile products,
automation, and reliable end-to-end product delivery.

This blog is a minimal public notebook for technical write-ups: architecture,
benchmarks, implementation decisions, product-quality trade-offs, and the
philosophy behind tools that should be fast, reliable, and simple to operate.

## Current Themes

- Developer tools for large codebases and CI/CD.
- AI-assisted software development with deterministic quality gates.
- Architecture that stays understandable under real production pressure.
- Research-driven product building: prototype, measure, simplify, ship.
